## Price in GBP

## Key Specifications

The Dell UltraSharp U2725QE is a 27-inch 4K UHD (3840x2160) IPS Black professional monitor running at 120Hz with exceptional image quality — 450 cd/m² brightness, a 3000:1 contrast ratio and VESA DisplayHDR 600.

Additional features include:

- IPS Black Panel Technology with enhanced contrast and 99% DCI-P3 color
- A Thunderbolt 4 hub delivering high-speed connectivity and up to 140W laptop charging over a single cable, alongside HDMI and DisplayPort
- Viewing angles of 178 degrees
- Factory-calibrated colour, a fully ergonomic stand and ComfortView Plus

For the specific UK retail price in GBP, I'd recommend checking the Dell UK website directly at dell.com/en-uk to see the current full price listed.
